finding.claim: Unrestricted SSRF in /preview: the url query parameter is passed directly to requests.get with no scheme, host, or IP validation, and the response status and body are returned to the caller.

trace.note: Passes unvalidated value to requests.get, which follows redirects by default
Returns status code and first 500 chars of response body to caller

finding.guards_checked: None on path. No scheme, host, IP, or port allow-list; redirects followed by default. Reaches internal hosts and cloud metadata (e.g. 169.254.169.254) and the body is readable.

verdict.guard_found: none. app.py:15-17 (the /preview handler) has no scheme, host, IP, or port check before requests.get(target, timeout=5) at app.py:16, and the response status and text[:500] are returned at app.py:17. The only allow-list, ALLOWED_HOSTS at app.py:9 with the check at app.py:23-25, is in /partner and does not cover /preview.
verdict.reason: The url query parameter at app.py:15 is unauthenticated attacker input that flows unvalidated into requests.get at app.py:16, which follows redirects by default, and the status and body are returned to the caller at app.py:17, so no closing guard exists on the /preview path.

finding.claim: Host allow-list in /partner can be bypassed via HTTP redirects on an allowed host: the check is applied only to the initial URL's hostname, while requests.get follows redirects by default and allow_redirects is not disabled. Conditional on an open redirect existing on an allow-listed host. Parser differential between urllib.parse and urllib3 was not verified.

trace.note: Checks hostname membership in ALLOWED_HOSTS; only guard on path
Passes original unparsed target to requests.get, which follows redirects; a 3xx from an allowed host can point to internal addresses
Returns only status code, not body

finding.guards_checked: Hostname allow-list at app.py:24 (string hostname check, no IP resolution or connect-time check, no scheme check, redirects not disabled). DNS rebinding not a route unless attacker controls an allow-listed name. Requests rejects non-http(s) schemes. /health (app.py:30-33) not reported: URL is a server-side env var constant.

verdict.guard_found: app.py:24 — exact set membership of urlparse(target).hostname in ALLOWED_HOSTS (app.py:9), applied before the sink at app.py:26. No redirect-related check exists anywhere in app.py.
verdict.reason: All trace lines (app.py:22, 23, 24, 26, 27) are accurate, and the url parameter is attacker-controlled, but app.py:24 is an exact hostname set-membership guard that the rubric treats as closing the finding. The redirect bypass the candidate describes also depends on an open redirect on an allow-listed host, which cannot be verified from this code, so it is at most a conditional concern and not a standalone CONFIRMED finding.
